sentences.text: The Dutch never vote for their head of state. So who's in charge?
King Willem-Alexander inherited the crown. His daughter Amalia is next.
He signs every law, but his ministers take the responsibility.
Voters fill all 150 seats in the House of Representatives, at least every four years.
The 75 senators? Provincial councils choose them, not the people directly.
In 2025, D66 and the PVV tied with 26 seats each. A majority needs 76.
After 117 days of coalition talks, the King swore in Rob Jetten's cabinet, with 66 seats.
Is it really democracy if you don't vote for your head of state?
